- **Synth bass now shows on longer clips.** The synth bass tag comes from the trained tagger (round 31, trained with synth bass and bass-guitar examples) at cutoff 0.7261 instead of being held back on clips over 2.25 s. On NSynth test 82% of its calls are right and it finds 53%; on bass-guitar recordings it wrongly fires on 1.6%, inside the 2% false-alarm cap. These test figures were also used to pick this model, so expect a little less on new audio ([#340](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/340)).
- **Vocal shout is much more accurate.** The tagger's vocal shout output now comes from round 31, trained with screams and cheering as shouts, at cutoff 0.7752. On FSD50K eval (screams and cheers counted as shouts) it finds 61% of shouts with 74% of calls right, up from 32% found; on practice clips 67% found, 74% right ([#339](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/339)).
- **Vocal shout counts screams, cheers and crowd shouts, and fires on fewer plain voices.** Following the owner's rule (screams, cheers and crowd shouts are shouts), the vocal shout cutoff moves from 0.03 to 0.07. On FSD50K eval relabelled that way, precision rises from .577 to .659 and recall drops from .451 to .330, so loud talking is tagged as a shout less often ([#336](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/336)).
- **Cymbal tags are more precise but less frequent.** The cymbal tag now reads the FSD50K-trained cymbal detector at cutoff 0.09 (chosen on practice clips only). On FSD50K eval its precision rises from .549 to .721 and recall drops from .902 to .739, so you will see fewer cymbal tags and fewer wrong ones. On cymbal-free music clips it fires slightly less often than before ([#334](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/334)).
- Welcome start actions put **Add files**, **Load demo corpus** and **Load audio demo** first. **Add a folder** and **Import a graph** are quieter links, and the workspace tool list starts collapsed.
- Welcome screen matches the Resonance workspace. The headline covers sounds and documents, the demo is labeled as 100 sample documents, and the card lists the real workspace tools (graph, library, sample assistant, search, filters, insights, export) with working entry points for adding files, opening a folder, loading the demo, importing a graph, Settings and Help. The hero is the lime node-network render (`design/hero/`), with the headline on the open left field. ([#254](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/254))
- Roadmaps and SECURITY.md now match the shipped BGE-small embedding model (leftover unused `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` tokenizer files removed).
- OpenRouter chat and enrichment LLM clients honour the `Retry-After` response header on 429/502/503 (shared `parseRetryAfter` helper, capped at 60s) before falling back to exponential backoff. ([#12](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/12))
- Node 24 is the declared runtime: `.nvmrc`, `engines.node` (`>=22`), and the release workflow now agree with CI and the Docker image (the release workflow previously built on Node 22). The release workflow also checks that the tag matches `package.json` **before** spending minutes on builds instead of after. ([#87](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/87))
- Removed four orphaned modules that nothing imported: `WorkspaceChrome`, `ThemeToggle`, `ClusterAtmosphere`, and `NebulaClouds`. (`audio/evaluationSignals` stays: it is a documented helper library for the evaluation workflow in `docs/audio-evaluation-infrastructure.md`, not dead code.) ([#87](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/87))
- `scripts/sanitize-airgap.mjs` now also neutralizes `signaling.yjs.dev` in the air-gapped bundle and documents which attribution-link hostnames it deliberately leaves alone. ([#87](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/87))
- README and AGENTS.md state that the first `npm run dev` / `npm run build` needs network access for the ~190 MB audio-model download, and that `npm run setup:music` pre-fetches it for offline work. ([#87](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/87))
- The portable Windows runtime (`npm run build:exe`) is now a Node **Single Executable Application** built by `scripts/build-win-exe.mjs`: esbuild bundles the launcher, `node --experimental-sea-config` writes the blob, the official Windows `node.exe` of the same Node version is downloaded and SHA-256-verified against `SHASUMS256.txt`, and `postject` injects the blob. A `--self-test` boots a host-platform SEA against `dist/` and checks it serves the app and refuses path traversal; `scripts/verify-win-exe.mjs` gates the final exe (x64 PE, SEA fuse on, `NODE_SEA_BLOB` resource, icon). This drops `pkg` (archived upstream, unfixable GHSA-22r3-9w55-cj54, Node 18-only) and ships a current Node runtime instead of end-of-life Node 18. The exe is larger (~80 MB vs ~40 MB) because it is an unstripped official build. ([#87](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/87))

### Fixed
- Follow mode now maps presenter selection and camera onto the follower's local documents by title/hash (not disk path), delivers a hung layout-settle camera after 8s, and labels collaboration as "You + N others" instead of counting the local client as a peer. ([#33](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/33))
- Collaboration invite hashes ask before joining; notes/tags stay local unless opted in; public STUN is disabled (host ICE only); share-link summaries can be up to 2000 characters (connection evidence is capped at 200). ([#37](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/37))
- Batch enrichment now sends each document's **full stored text** to the provider. Previously only the first 1,200 characters were included, so summaries and topics were written from a stub. Enormous files are truncated only as a last resort at `DOCUMENT_AI_MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS` (240,000 characters); batches split when that would overflow a typical model context window. Settings, SECURITY.md, and the user guide disclose the full-text send. ([#17](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/17))
- Fixed flicker in the UI, the graph and the home screen ([#58](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/58), [#62](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/62), [#65](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/65)).
- Fixed camera freezes and an unresponsive graph after closing a node panel ([#41](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/41), [#49](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/49), [#50](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/50)), and follow-mode camera sync ([#30](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/30), [#31](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/31), [#35](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/35)).
- Ingestion recovers after failures, and stale note recovery no longer overwrites newer edits or deleted shared notes ([#80](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/80), [#83](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/83), [#84](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/84)).
- Fixed folder-ingest wikilinks, same-name link jumps, the enrichment queue, ingest cancel and search invalidation ([#20](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/20), [#22](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/22)).
- The first-run guide now shows after loading the demo corpus ([#54](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/54)).
- Audio analysis is no longer blocked by the production security policy ([#82](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/82)).
- Fixed audio playback and waveform failures ([#160](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/160)), audio model recovery ([#161](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/161), [#174](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/174)), and the FFmpeg decoder running out of memory or starting after close ([#102](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/102), [#107](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/107)).
- Key detection no longer calls minor tracks major, and the trained key model is used for song keys ([#123](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/123), [#140](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/140)).
